title: Coverage-Type Change Terms for TRICARE Premium-Based Plans
content:
Under the **TRICARE Premium-Based Plans**, a qualifying life event may move a purchaser between member-only and member-and-family coverage only in the tiers marked "allowed" below; the move is always to the tier named in the target column, and it must be requested within the tier's change window, counted in calendar days after the event recorded in DEERS. A window of 0 means not applicable.

| Tier held | Change on a qualifying life event | Change window (calendar days after the DEERS event) | Tier the change moves to |
|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-Only | allowed | 90 | TRICARE Reserve Select Member-and-Family |
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-and-Family | allowed | 90 | TRICARE Reserve Select Member-Only |
| TRICARE Young Adult Select | not allowed | 0 (not applicable) | not applicable |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-Only | allowed | 90 | TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-and-Family |
| TRICARE Young Adult Prime | not allowed | 0 (not applicable) | not applicable |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-and-Family | allowed | 90 | TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-Only |

## Quick answers from the table

- A TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-Only purchaser can move only to TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-and-Family, never to a TRICARE Reserve Select tier.
- Neither TRICARE Young Adult tier has a coverage-type change, so its change window is not applicable.
- For every tier that allows a change, the window is 90 calendar days after the DEERS event.
